audit_type: Independent recommendation verification; source-and-test inspection only

route.model_evidence: The active developer instructions identify this coding agent as gpt-6.1-sol.

summary.conclusion: All twelve recommendations received current-source and relevant test inspection. Most preserve existing guarantees and reuse implemented mechanisms. The important additional constraint is that ready-source batching rejects candidate contexts: product-stage adoption must occur on the ready-context side of the candidate boundary, not indiscriminately during the interview. Confirmed-scope resume needs instruction precision, but a new reader contract is not justified until the existing cold-context route is adjudicated. Follow-up report identity is useful, not evidence that current standalone reviews force full reruns. No performance savings were measured.
summary.completion_meaning: The assigned independent verification is complete. Accepted means a supported recommendation, not an implemented change, executed test pass, installed-runtime certification, or measured benefit. Narrowed recommendations explicitly exclude the unverified or unsafe extension.

method.instructions: Read protocol.md first, then the personal tool-search guide and docs/index.md. Applied the personal and repository AGENTS.md supplied in active context. Instruction discovery found no narrower instruction governing inspected current sources or the audit directory.
method.independence: Checked implementation branches, guards, call boundaries and test assertions rather than accepting primary summaries. No author was asked to approve a verdict. No descendants, workflows or parent messaging were used.
method.codegraph: Discovered CodeGraph, used it first for code exploration, and treated its current line-numbered source as read. Broad queries sometimes included historical incidental snippets; those were not evidence. Targeted file reads supplied omitted current ranges. No index was created or regenerated.
method.state_access: No live managed YAML, workflow archive, product state or scenario was read or parsed. Source and test code describing YAML handling was inspected as code. Scenario tool execution was unnecessary. JSON audit metadata and reports were read normally.
method.execution: Only file discovery/reads, source exploration, read-only Git diagnostics, byte hashing and audit-artifact validation were performed. No audited skill, verifier, tests, benchmark, build, generator, installation, publishing, commit or push was run.
method.fidelity_boundary: Did not repeat generated-host semantic audits or recheck every generated copy. Primary fidelity measurements are acknowledged only as their scoped historical audit results; no process recommendation relies on treating them as fresh V01 performance measurements.
method.preservation: Initial Git status showed extensive pre-existing tracked and untracked work. No existing file was edited. Exact-path discovery showed V01.json did not exist before creation. This report is the sole write by V01.

findings.title: Adopt the existing exact ready-source batch reader in task authoring roles

evidence.observation: Specification and planning explicitly direct separate element and decision gets for every required source.
Implementation already specifies the batch preference, both continuation layers, exact fallbacks and required-source preservation.

The batch uses the same exact readers, one loaded ready state, ordered-query/source-bound cursors, and complete-envelope budgets. It is not purpose-specific, but requires ready context with candidate_ref null.
Tests assert exact portions, item continuations, reordered-query rejection, pin protection, corruption detection and real public response-envelope bounds.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Batching already exists and is already documented for implementation. Selected context and source-level continuations remain mandatory; this is adoption, not a missing API.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: Several short required ready elements/decisions can share a batch instead of separate dispatches. A large item may remain partial even on the outer final page. The source establishes the instruction asymmetry, not actual actor call counts.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Prefer the advertised existing batch for already-required ready sources in the Specification and Planning role paragraphs; reuse the implementation wording and retain single-reader fallback. Keep task scope consent independent of product profiles.
findings.guarantees: No source omission, summary substitution, new cache or managed-state access fallback. Keep exact ready context, source pins, ordering, all portions, response limits and freshness recovery. A different actor must receive its own sources.

duplication_links.relation: Same existing ready-source-batch adoption family; different consumer entry points. Count one shared optimization with role-specific routing, not two independent API improvements.

findings.validation_plan: Extend instruction assertions and reuse existing exact-source public tests. Add specification/planning-purpose fixtures; compare exact reconstructed sources and cursor behavior before measuring call count and wall time.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small canonical instruction change, focused tests and separately authorized generated-bundle updates. Requires advertised batch capability.
findings.confidence: High on source asymmetry and capability; unmeasured adoption and net savings.

findings.title: Defer substantive quality-manual disclosure until confirmed design eligibility

evidence.observation: Bundle verification and both quality-manual reads precede the no-design-output early stop; Penpot guidance and design schemas are already deferred.
The verifier checks actual manual/test bytes and expected digests independently of substantive model disclosure.
Existing assertions cover separate explicit routing, dependency, invocation policy and size, not the no-op disclosure ordering.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: The stage already stops without outputs; no eager Penpot/schema loading defect exists. Main planning already assigns a separate stage only for declared outputs.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A separately invoked valid post-plan no-output case loads the two manuals before returning not applicable. This is a cold-context no-op refinement, not a normal design-path regression.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Keep bundle verification, approved-plan prerequisites and mandatory scenario/state-access guidance. Determine confirmed manifest eligibility before substantive engineering/test manual disclosure; eligible work still loads both unchanged before operating.
findings.guarantees: Use MCP-confirmed state rather than directly reading YAML or inferring eligibility from screen files. Contradictory or legacy declarations still require reconciliation; no design writes, external routing or handoff mutation on the no-op path.
findings.validation_plan: Add eligible, no-output and contradictory-declaration instruction/trace cases. Verify that bundle failure still stops first and eligible operations cannot precede manual delivery. Measure cold/no-op disclosure only under separate authority.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small entry ordering change and focused contract test; low priority because proper planning usually avoids the no-op invocation.
findings.confidence: High on source order, low-to-moderate on frequency and benefit.

findings.title: Clarify unchanged confirmed-scope reuse; do not presume a new reader is needed
findings.classification: source-confirmed instruction ambiguity and conditional reset; benefit unmeasured

evidence.observation: Answer reuse and exact candidate resume are followed by an unconditional proposal step.
The same ordering occurs for Technical Design.
Ordinary resume repeats the proposal instruction; retirement already has its separate branch.
Saved-answer reuse coexists with the proposal/confirmation instruction.
The shared interview path contains the same ambiguity.

Replay identity includes the original selected source version. Latest-context unchanged reproposal is a new operation that clears confirmed_answer. Resume reports unresolved questions or complete, not the confirmed scope. Draft replay returns a refreshed candidate context, not a scope summary.
The candidate record reader requires an already-known decision/research identity; it is not a candidate scope inventory.
Published handlers expose resume, exact candidate record retrieval and scope writes, but no scope-get handler in this inspected set.
Tests protect exact old-input replay and affirmative/no-answer confirmation, not latest-context unchanged reproposal avoidance.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Applicable-answer reuse is already mandatory and exact original requests already replay. A careful actor can avoid reproposal. Scope reset on an intentional new proposal is not itself an idempotency defect.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: After confirmation or a semantic write advances candidate context, mechanically following the next proposal step creates a fresh unresolved scope question despite unchanged requested scope. This is conditional instruction-following risk, not an observed universal reprompt.
findings.narrowing: Accept the explicit unchanged-resume branch. Do not endorse a public reader/result extension as established necessity. The selected public reader inventory does not prove that every other existing discovery route is insufficient, and cold-context scope/provenance retrieval was already deferred by the primary report to P09.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Skip proposal/confirmation only when authoritative evidence establishes the same current candidate's applicable confirmed scope and actual-answer provenance. Keep changed or unresolved scope on the existing native-answer path. Establish the existing cold-context read route before specifying an additive bounded resume summary.
findings.guarantees: No default scope, opaque-context decoding, remembered answer, different candidate or upstream pin can substitute for current confirmation evidence. Preserve version conflicts, exact replay, actual-answer provenance and profile gating. Do not change intentional new-proposal reset semantics merely to avoid a prompt.

duplication_links.relation: Contract/discovery ownership dependency, not a verified duplicate finding ID. V02/P09 should settle the cold-context reader question before any API addition.

findings.validation_plan: Add current-context unchanged-resume, cold-context resume, changed scope/upstream inputs, pending scope and no-answer cases. Assert preserved confirmation reference and no extra proposal only when authoritative evidence is available. Existing exact replay negatives remain mandatory.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small instruction change if the read route exists; contract work remains conditional and requires P09/V02 confirmation.
findings.confidence: High on reset/replay behavior; medium on wording risk; cold-context route and practical incidence unresolved.
findings.adjudication_question: Which existing published read-only operation supplies a cold actor with the current candidate's depth, active profiles and exact confirmed-answer provenance? If none does, what is the smallest additive extension to an existing reader, and which negative tests prove it cannot inherit stale or foreign confirmation?

findings.title: Conditionally deliver consumer/retirement/reviewer details without losing shared obligations

evidence.observation: Standalone mode avoids the durable protocol, but durable mode requires the full read.
PRD requires the whole shared protocol.
Technical Design requires the whole protocol.
Whole-protocol delivery precedes selection of retirement versus ordinary authoring.
Task consumer, retirement, interview and independent review procedures share one fully required source. The implementation role already routes to a smaller owned contract.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Standalone mode, confirmed-profile routing and implementation-specific startup already avoid some irrelevant reads. The proposed change must preserve those mechanisms, not replace them with a new cache.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A new PRD author receives task packet reconciliation and retirement recovery detail for operations outside that invocation. This is confirmed mandatory instruction exposure, not measured latency or proof of model distraction.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Keep an unconditional shared base for access, pins, consent, stage boundaries, safety/recovery stop rules and independent-review handoff. Deliver detailed task-consumer, retirement and reviewer procedures only to their owning role before affected operations. Use reliable section routing where possible; split canonical references only if necessary.
findings.guarantees: Move rather than delete obligations. Reviewers must receive their own exact protocol and sources. All roles retain no-YAML-fallback, untrusted-data, prerequisite, provenance and current-source rules. Update bundle resource enumeration, digests, tests and generated hosts coherently under separate authorization.

duplication_links.relation: Related progressive disclosure principle, but a different eligibility/role boundary; not a duplicate finding.

findings.validation_plan: Create an obligation-to-role map and assert reachability before each owning operation, including recovery. Preserve negative tests for missing safety base and reviewer inputs; compare bounded cold-context deliveries only after semantic preservation.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small-to-medium canonical routing change, with packaging/digest work owned by the distribution maintainer. No new runtime mechanism.
findings.confidence: High on unnecessary exposure; net process effect unmeasured.

findings.title: Batch selected upstream ready sources before crossing into candidate context
findings.classification: source-confirmed adoption opportunity with a material context-boundary constraint; benefit unmeasured

evidence.observation: Ready PRD context selection precedes candidate draft; draft then returns a candidate context.
Ready upstream selection also precedes candidate draft here.
The generic interview paragraph starts by creating/resuming a candidate before its context-inventory wording. An undifferentiated batch rule here would conceal the ready/candidate boundary.
decodeContext rejects candidate_ref other than null. Both context selection and the source batch use loadState and therefore accept only ready-revision contexts.
Draft replay refreshes a selected candidate context. It is not interchangeable with ready context.
The reusable batch/cursor rule already exists for ready-source consumers.
Batch tests substantiate exact ready-source delivery and budgets; they do not establish acceptance of candidate contexts.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Existing batch and exact single ready readers share the same context restriction. Candidate evidence already has its own exact reader; receipt-bearing review tools are a separate path.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A Technical Design or Roadmap actor can batch several already-selected ready sources while it still has the matching ready context. Passing the latest candidate context after product_artifact_draft instead fails INVALID_INPUT before delivery. No source savings can be claimed for that invalid route.
findings.narrowing: The primary recommendation's generic product-interview wording is too broad without an explicit ready-context phase. Do not imply that an arbitrary latest candidate context can call the ready-source batch, that it retrieves candidate records, or that these implementation-only fixtures validate every product-stage route.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Put the batch preference alongside the pre-draft ready-context selection in Technical Design/Roadmap and any other applicable ready-input phase. Exhaust both cursor layers before discarding that context. For later candidate work use candidate readers; do not overwrite the candidate mutation context with an unrelated ready-reader response. Any later ready-source retrieval needs an explicitly valid, generation-matched ready context and its own lifecycle rules, or must stop on unavailable exact evidence.
findings.guarantees: Preserve selected generation, exact pins, actual required-source scope, candidate mutation freshness, independent review receipts and single-reader fallback. Do not synthesize a ready context by decoding/rewriting opaque candidate state or broaden the API merely for adoption.

duplication_links.relation: Duplicate optimization family: reuse the same ready-source batching guidance, with this distinct product-stage context-boundary qualification.

findings.validation_plan: Add a stage-specific pre-draft ready-context batch equivalence case and a candidate-context rejection case. Verify retained exact text remains bound to the same actor/inputs, stale ready pins cannot leak into candidate decisions, and mutation contexts remain separate. Existing budget/cursor tests are reusable controls, not proof of this routing.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small canonical routing change. V02/P09 should adjudicate any proposed after-draft route before a generalized shared-interview edit. No new reader is justified by this finding alone.
findings.confidence: High on ready-context rejection and pre-draft applicability; later in-interview ready-source recovery remains outside the accepted recommendation.
findings.adjudication_question: Will synthesis constrain this adoption rule to the existing pre-draft ready-context phase? If a general in-interview rule is retained, identify the exact published generation-matched ready-context retrieval/lifetime route after candidate creation and prove that using it cannot replace the candidate's mutation context or silently advance its upstream generation.

findings.title: Add compact source-bound follow-up handoff information, not a mandatory audit ledger
findings.classification: source-confirmed report omission; avoided repeat work remains a hypothesis

evidence.observation: Already establishes comparison range, task-scoped inspection, concrete evidence and check status, but does not explicitly retain source/check identity for another invocation.
Already scopes the trust-boundary inspection and bounded report; no explicit cross-invocation evidence reuse contract.
Existing evidence reuse rules bind owner, purpose, inputs and state, and prohibit treating different boundaries as duplicates.
Modeled evidence/control assertions do not demonstrate an actual broad rerun or a follow-up identity scenario.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Both skills already support narrow requested scope, and code review already records comparison range. Their instructions do not force a full original inspection on follow-up. Shared validation reuse already exists, but these standalone skills do not automatically depend on that manual.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A new reviewer with only an old prose report may need to reconstruct dirty-file identities and affected check inputs. However, for a one-shot tiny review, maintaining a separate input ledger could add more work than it saves. No executed trace establishes repeated broad work.
findings.narrowing: Retain the handoff/freshness clarification but do not present omission as a forced-rerun defect or require exhaustive check/input hashes in every report. The efficiency claim stays hypothetical until a matched multi-round trial.
findings.minimal_recommendation: In the existing bounded report, include a sufficient scoped comparison/input identity, exclusions and unresolved findings, especially when follow-up is expected. On an explicitly requested follow-up, inspect corrections and affected interactions, reuse only demonstrably unchanged deterministic evidence, and expand when identity or semantic influence is uncertain. No separate artifact, whole-tree hash, schema, dependency or mandatory ledger.
findings.guarantees: Dirty/untracked relevant sources need adequate identity; a commit alone may be insufficient. Security assumptions, configuration and shared policy changes invalidate affected evidence. Fresh substantive review cannot be inherited from implementation checks or another actor's source consumption. Reviews remain optional explicit invocations.

duplication_links.relation: Related compact identity convention but different operation: sequential fix verification versus asynchronous adversarial review. Reuse wording, not another shared framework.

findings.validation_plan: Add modeled stale/missing-evidence and interacting-fix cases, then separately measure an isolated one-shot control and narrow/broad-impact follow-ups. Compare defect detection and bookkeeping cost as well as repeated deterministic work.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small canonical instruction/fixture refinement; behavioral benefit requires a later authorized trial.
findings.confidence: High on report omission; medium on handoff usefulness; repeat-work frequency and net savings unmeasured.

findings.title: Bind neutral reviewer input and parent reconciliation to the same artifact/contract identity
findings.classification: source-confirmed freshness clarification; runtime incidence and benefit unmeasured

evidence.observation: Fresh native review, neutral artifact/contract input and substantive parent reconciliation are explicit. Mutable-source identity and drift disposition are implicit.
Tests preserve fresh-context/no-claim/no-self-review behavior but do not bind source versions.
Positive modeled reviewer packet has artifact/contract roles and fresh-context flags, not consumed identity.
Existing scenario guidance distinguishes actor-specific exact delivery and identity from summaries and retained names; this is precedent, not an automatic dependency of the standalone skill.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: The skill already extracts a smallest artifact/contract and stops when fresh review is unavailable. Reconciliation may already detect drift; there is no observed stale-review incident. Immutable supplied content needs no extra snapshot mechanism.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: Concurrent modification of a mutable artifact or contract between dispatch and reconciliation can mix meanings. Fresh conversation context alone does not establish that both actors judged the same source revision.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Include an existing immutable or scoped content identity in the neutral packet, identify what the reviewer actually consumed, and compare relevant identities before the parent recommendation. On drift, retain the old result as historical and obtain fresh independent review of affected scope; broaden or disclose unavailability when impact cannot be bounded.
findings.guarantees: Keep claim/prior reasoning/desired verdict excluded. Identity is not consent, comprehension or semantic proof. Do not require a clean tree, whole-session forwarding, snapshot files, global cache, self-review substitution or unauthorized external CLI. Experiments remain proposals.

duplication_links.relation: Share a small identity convention if useful, but do not collapse independent semantic review into deterministic evidence reuse.

findings.validation_plan: Add artifact-only drift, contract-only drift, immutable stable control and unavailable-fresh-review-after-drift cases. Compare the actual consumed identity and seeded contract defects; unchanged inputs should not trigger an automatic second review.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small instruction/fixture change; controlled asynchronous behavior trial later. No MCP/storage dependency needed.
findings.confidence: High on missing explicit binding; practical incidence and savings unmeasured.

findings.title: Reuse adaptive response budgeting at the two correction-text portion sites

evidence.observation: Both handlers rebuild impact and call portion without a page-size argument. Structured evidence delivers one exact field fragment; summary navigation does not replace it.
Default remains 1024 code points; supported maximum is 4096 and size is not part of the source identity.
Review-get already uses 4096 with complete-envelope fallback; repeating a recommendation for that caller would be obsolete.
Existing helper counts structured UTF-8 payload and duplicated/escaped full wire response.
Long Unicode finding, legacy/structured exact reconstruction and incomplete/foreign/stale/tampered evidence guards are already represented.
Tests explicitly exercise variable page sizes and complete-envelope escaping limits.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Larger adaptive review-get and bounded progress cache already exist. Many short fields still require separate structured fragments; this proposal does not solve or claim to solve that separate contract cost.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A long finding explanation or before/after field exceeds 1024 code points while the response envelope could safely carry more. More fragments repeat impact reconstruction and envelopes without adding evidence.
findings.minimal_recommendation: At only the two correction-text callers, reuse the existing adaptive approach with the real refreshed context-bearing success envelope. Keep global default, public schemas, report/field identity, receipt calculation and ordering unchanged. No new report cache or batching API.
findings.guarantees: Exact text reconstruction, old/new cursor compatibility, stale/tamper rejection and terminal-only changes_receipt remain mandatory. Budget failure cannot appear as completion; summaries cannot authorize follow-up. Keep readConsistent guards.
findings.validation_plan: Extend current structured/legacy tests with long escaped Unicode fields, old/new page-size transitions, exact receipt equality and full response limits. Measure only matched long-field call/handler changes after separately authorized implementation.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small local adaptation; must budget the actual outer readConsistent response, not merely its fragment. Coordinate with general budget ownership without changing the default globally.
findings.confidence: High on repeated default-sized work; runtime magnitude unmeasured.

findings.title: Key cached final bodies by observed result dependencies rather than retained caller versions
findings.classification: source-confirmed dependency mismatch and conditional supported-read scenario; not a runtime reproduction

evidence.observation: The snapshot loads current ledger data but assigns decisions_version from input context. Behavioral source hash excludes specification review results.
Bounded cache key includes that context version; enhanced final body includes run.results. Consistency receipt binds both materialized body and current results.
Get constructs snapshot/body before obtaining its refreshed output context; it does not require physical-context equality for a read.
Load returns actual bytes/version without mutating caller versions; result refreshes output. A new write still checks actual current version.
Consistency record recomputes its receipt from the current write snapshot and rejects mismatches.
Existing early-read regression adopts updated actor context. It does not reread through a retained old observer context under the warm cache key.
Read-only observers are expected to see current progress without disturbing another writer.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Four-entry/64 MiB bounds, latest-write-context convention, current write version checks and consistency-result binding already exist. They prevent treating this as an approval bypass; they do not make a retained-key cached read fresh.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: Prime a final body at C0; another client records a detailed verdict without behavioral-source change; reread using retained C0 before eviction. The loaded result set is new, but the cache can return the old detailed_results body. The refreshed context can then invalidate a continuation or expose an INCOMPLETE_READ when the old-body receipt is recorded. Ordinary latest-context coordinator calls avoid this edge.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Carry the actually observed decisions-byte identity into read snapshots and ensure enhanced-final keys include all in-memory result dependencies for supplied-ledger callers. Retain the existing bounded cache, exact body format, write freshness and receipt algorithm. Do not accept stale receipts as a workaround.
findings.guarantees: Cold/warm and retained/current-context reads must materialize the same current snapshot. Preserve status fidelity, project/spec/run separation, follow-up attribution and source-bound cursors. A genuinely changed body may invalidate a cursor; no removal of mandatory final semantic judgment.
findings.validation_plan: Add a two-client retained-C0 warm-cache regression alongside the existing updated-context case. Compare exact detailed_results, terminal receipt recording with refreshed context, paginated continuation, cold cache, eviction, restart and supplied-ledger behavior. Do not claim an incident or bypass without execution.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small-to-moderate snapshot/cache dependency correction; general storage redesign is unnecessary. Validate receipt and mutation interactions before further read-efficiency changes.
findings.confidence: High under retained-context/warm-cache conditions; frequency and elapsed effect unmeasured.

findings.title: Remove repeated whole-inventory searches while skipping an acknowledged suffix
findings.classification: source-confirmed deterministic complexity opportunity; wall-clock effect unmeasured

evidence.observation: nextIndex uses findIndex from zero; each skipped acknowledged entry calls it again. From constraints filter results but do not start traversal at from.
Existing Unicode partial-item test deliberately pre-acknowledges a suffix, retains the partial index and expects one empty terminating page.
Canonical pending-only traversal explicitly requires the supported empty-page termination path and keeps status for recovery, not every serial advance.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Pending-only skipping, bounded batches, source verification, item continuation and empty termination already work. The problem is repeated search, not missing resumption or a reason to remove the final page.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: With an all-acknowledged inventory of N items starting at zero, each of N skip branches invokes a search that inspects all N predicates before returning -1: quadratic predicate work. A shorter acknowledged suffix similarly repeats avoidable scans. This source complexity is not an elapsed-time measurement.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Use the forward iteration to skip acknowledged runs, with a single exhaustion/successor computation as needed. Start any lookahead at its actual position. Preserve the exact next-index contract, including partial-block retention and empty/null termination; no persistent pending index.
findings.guarantees: Do not skip unacknowledged evidence after a lost response, drop source verification, change order or weaken byte/receipt limits. Keep request-local state only and preserve recovery/status ownership.

duplication_links.relation: Same batch function but a separate repeated computation. Can share a focused benchmark; verify independently before combining.

findings.validation_plan: Add all-acknowledged, sparse pending, nonzero start, partial block, byte truncation and lost-ack cases. Assert exact keys/indexes and count predicates at increasing synthetic sizes before comparing timing.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small local scan change; constant extra space is sufficient. Existing Unicode/empty-termination regression is a required semantic control.
findings.confidence: High on quadratic edge-case predicate count; material wall-clock benefit unmeasured.

findings.title: Compute required recheck membership and batch progress once per unchanged loaded state
findings.classification: source-confirmed repeated deterministic work; benefit unmeasured

evidence.observation: Inherited counting invokes requiredRecheckKeys for each verdict, allocating the same pending/expansion Set repeatedly.
Every candidate portion and size-halving retry calls statusFor only to obtain next_item_index. loadUsedVerdict replaces a body for an existing key; it does not add verdict membership.
Tests assert 118 inherited attributions, one fresh verdict, scope expansion and stale-consistency invalidation.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: Inventory reuse, stored impact and exact inherited attribution already exist. The new bindings can remain function/request local; a cross-call status cache is unnecessary.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: A recheck with many saved verdicts rebuilds identical required membership once per key. A multi-item or byte-halved batch repeats full status derivation despite unchanged membership. The test fixture proves relevant shape, not production load or cost.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Compute requiredRecheckKeys once within the recheck status branch and reuse it for inherited counting. Compute batch next_item_index once from the loaded state and reuse that scalar for portions/retries. Recompute after mutations or expansion.
findings.guarantees: Status JSON, pending/inherited counts, expansion handling, consistency exclusion and response shapes must remain identical. No inheritance/source/receipt check is removed; no mutable value escapes the request.

duplication_links.relation: Distinct local work reduction in the same reader; do not multiply claimed savings or treat one fix as validating the other.

findings.validation_plan: Reuse existing attribution/expansion regressions; add exact status-output equivalence and construction/invocation counts, including first-item response halving, zero/all inherited and consistency-key exclusion. Benchmark allocations separately from I/O.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small local bindings and focused tests; no API, storage or new cache dependency.
findings.confidence: High on repeated computations and safe request-local lifetime; net effect unmeasured.

findings.title: Extend the existing read-only audit scope over the complete single-item operation
findings.classification: source-confirmed missing outer reuse scope; I/O and latency effect unmeasured

evidence.observation: Single-item load has an inner object-read scope, then verifies used sources outside it; sourceChecks starts empty apart from history. Batch has an encompassing scope.

Cold full audit reads verdict bodies; loadUsedVerdict unconditionally reopens/revalidates the requested verdict, even if already hydrated. An outer object scope can reuse immutable bytes, though the logical validation remains.
Existing AsyncLocalStorage reuse is audit-local and keyed by store/path/hash. readObject uses it; transaction entry explicitly discards preflight reuse.
The public single-item handler directly calls readProductReviewItem.
No encompassing product-object read scope exists in the inspected dispatch.
Existing tests protect per-audit reuse, full-versus-metadata distinction, transaction invalidation and different-store separation.
Warm status versus used-source/full-completion corruption detection is intentional and must remain.

findings.existing_mechanisms_checked: The required reuse mechanism already exists in batch, consistency and mutation paths. No hidden outer server wrapper solves the single-item lifetime. The proposed scope does not eliminate logical checks, schema validation or every repeated parse.
findings.scenario_and_reasoning: In a fresh server process, a recorded source-backed item causes a cold audit to read its sources and verdict; after the inner scope ends, requested-source checks and loadUsedVerdict can read the same immutable objects again. Warm reads have a different cost profile and must remain a separate control.
findings.minimal_recommendation: Wrap the entire single-item read in the existing withProductObjectReads pattern, matching the batch reader. Keep reuse inside one owning read-only operation, not across calls, writes, locks or server lifetime.
findings.guarantees: Retain mutable candidate/review before-and-after checks, used-source verification, receipts, hash/safe-path validation and fresh under-lock validation. Corruption between requests must still fail. Do not convert audit markers into a content cache or use metadata-only evidence as a full audit.

duplication_links.relation: Supporting storage-boundary ownership only; no exact duplicate finding ID was supplied in this verification group. Check V02 synthesis before counting a second storage-wrapper recommendation.

findings.validation_plan: Add cold recorded-source single-item versus one-item-batch diagnostics and exact payload/receipt equivalence; include warm control. Corrupt retained source/verdict between requests and require failure. Preserve transaction invalidation and different-store tests. Reuse existing audit channels rather than a benchmark framework.
findings.complexity_and_dependencies: Small wrapper/extraction matching current batch pattern. Requires storage owner confirmation that the one-operation immutable-read lifetime remains unchanged.
findings.confidence: High on scope gap and repeat byte reads; primarily cold-path benefit remains unmeasured.

deduplication.retained_recommendation: One shared adoption rule with task-consumer and pre-draft product-stage entry points. Keep P02-F03's ready/candidate-context qualification. Neither proposes a new API.

A common lightweight convention may be reused, but sequential deterministic check reuse and fresh asynchronous semantic review have different guarantees. Do not merge them into inherited semantic approval.
Two independent local computations; share correctness fixtures if useful, but do not count a combined benchmark twice.

material_adjudication.owner: Synthesis should route only these conditional MCP-contract questions to the product context/interview owner through the existing V02/P09 assignment; V01 created no adjudicator.

questions.question: Identify the existing cold-context current confirmed-scope/provenance read route, or establish precisely why no reader supplies it before proposing a bounded additive resume result. Preserve changed-scope/no-answer rejection.

Accept the pre-draft ready-context restriction, or demonstrate a published generation-matched ready retrieval route usable after candidate creation without replacing the candidate mutation context. Current context.ts rejects candidate_ref non-null.

material_adjudication.effect_on_verdicts: The core instruction opportunities are verified and narrowed. New reader contracts and a general after-draft batching route are not approved by these verdicts; absent adjudication, synthesis must retain the narrowed recommendations rather than count those subclaims as verified.

no_finding_samples.result: Confirmed no mandatory independent-review or commit completion gate. One authorized packet, scoped final diff assessment, required local checks and entry/completion specification/agreement checks have distinct purposes.
